name: rcf-distill
description: Distill durable knowledge into one canonical destination with an optional auditable merge ledger.

interface.longDescription: Conservatively merges durable decisions, constraints, hypotheses, conflicts, residuals, and provenance into one canonical project knowledge file, with an optional append-only audit ledger for persisted or high-risk merges.
defaultPrompt: Distill this conversation into the canonical project knowledge file.
沉淀这段对话，把可复用内容合并到唯一知识主文件。
